author: /root/pirate_final_visual_review
review_method: Actually viewed all 19 original-resolution encoded contact sheets through view_image: every scene midpoint, the frame immediately before and after every scene cut, and actual movie first/last frames. Full fatal audiovisual decode is documented separately in the bound technical proof. This is not a claim of subjective viewing of every movie frame or subjective audio listening.
findings: PASS at all sampled encoded scenes and cuts. Recurring cast, costumes, principal sets, departure sail state, torn/repair sail story, storm/night/sunset changes and ending bucket callback remain coherent. No black/blank/corrupt sampled image or material framing defect observed.
minor_observations: A minor edge crop of the supporting captain during the storm-shot zoom is visible at the cut sample; the face identity and central crew action remain readable and this is not a material defect.

capture_sheets.notes: Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 001–009. Tom retains brown hair, blue vest, cream patched shirt and brown boots; the captain is distinct in burgundy coat/black hat. The repeated sunny quay houses, ropes and palms match across scenes 003–008. Opening bucket work and later tavern scene are fully framed; no black, blank or broken encoded panel.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 010–018. The quay/gangway progresses into the same furled-sail deck and wooden hold with ladder, mast and hammocks. Brown-vest quartermaster, green-shirt crewmate and burgundy captain remain distinguishable. Rope work, bag stowage, articles and bandaged hand are readable, with no actor clipping or missing image.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 019–027. Purse, crew meeting, line work, water/sack supplies, below-deck storage and ordinary tools preserve established cast and moored/furled deck. The main ship/harbor set remains consistent; all panels are readable and filled. Minor object detail differences do not change the action.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 028–036. Sail state changes from departure hoist to raised sailing, harbor recedes and the deck/mast layout persists. Line work, rigging climb, scrubbing and bucket work are recognizable. Food scenes remain in the same hold, with ordinary biscuit/meat portions and matching Tom/crewmate costumes; no black or corrupt frame.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 037–045. The brown-vest quartermaster is separate from blue-vest Tom and green crewmate. Depleted food, offering a small portion, medicine box and cup/rope duty are readable. Night hold scenes have a deliberate moon/lantern lighting shift, followed by storm-gray sailing; all captured compositions retain faces and intended action.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 046–054. Storm cleanup and a small torn sail section precede calmer deck views; the tear remains visible during later sea scenes. The distant merchant vessel stays distant. The same two worried captured adults appear on deck, and cargo handling preserves Tom/quartermaster/crewmate identities. No encoding blanks, broken framing or unexpected major set change.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 055–063. The hold/cargo checks, worried captured sailor and separate restrained quay aside are clear. Tom's blue vest and the captain's burgundy coat persist. Rain/storm appearance has ended deliberately; the damaged sail is retained at sea before the return to the sunny established harbor and furled mooring state. No black/blank panel or garbled image.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 064–072. Blond dealer, brown-vest quartermaster, Tom and green crewmate keep their roles. Cloth sale and modest purse payment are readable; the replacement cream shirt remains a folded item rather than an unexplained costume change. Tavern lantern/night and beach careening are distinct intentional settings; sail patching is visible before later repaired state.

Observed encoded midpoints for scenes 073–081. Articles/dispute, isolated beach aside, return to crew, worried quay discussion and captain scene are clear. The beach figure is the red-haired supporting sailor, not Tom. Returning quay houses/mast/furled sail stay stable, with Tom still in blue vest. Characters and hand gestures remain within frame; no encoded blank or severe clipping.

Observed encoded scenes 082–085 and exact cut endpoints 001→002 through 005→006. The tavern discussion leads deliberately to sunset quay/deck and night hold bucket callback. Tom's patched cream shirt/blue vest persists. Opening hard cuts and quay poses are fully filled, with no black flash or clipped primary face visible at these actual endpoints.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 006→007 through 014→015. The common sunny quay houses remain aligned within their respective shots; tavern and ship/hold cuts are deliberate location transitions. The brown-vest quartermaster enters separately from the green crewmate. All endpoint images are readable; zoom reset at scene change is bounded, with no missing image or black boundary frame.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 015→016 through 023→024. Same hold ladder/mast/hammocks recur, then moored deck articles/supplies scenes and the hold stowage view. Captain/quartermaster/crewmate identities stay stable across changed cast membership. Every sampled boundary is filled; there is no blank cut or severe subject crop.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 024→025 through 032→033. Furled moored sail changes to hoisted/raised sail only at the departure boundary 027→028; the shore disappears as the voyage begins. Deck layout, Tom's costume, captain coat and crewmate shirt persist. Climb-to-scrub and deck-to-hold cuts are deliberate action/location changes, with no black or missing boundary image.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 033→034 through 041→042. Food and illness scenes maintain the wooden hold arrangement and recurring blue/brown/green costume distinctions. The medicine box remains small and recognizable; deck duty resumes on a filled sea shot. All endpoint images are readable and there is no broken transition or unintended set replacement.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 042→043 through 050→051. Night/lantern rest, storm sailing, cleanup, damaged sail and merchant encounter follow intentional lighting/story shifts. The small tear is carried into later sea panels. Captain at the storm shot's left edge has a minor edge crop during the zoom, while his identity and the central crew action remain readable; no material framing defect, blank frame or cut corruption.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 051→052 through 059→060. The worried captured adults keep their recurring appearances, cloth cargo moves between deck and hold, and the separate enslaved-person aside uses the established sunny quay intentionally. Tom and green crewmate resume ordinary work afterward. No blank boundary, garbled actor or material camera crop observed.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 060→061 through 068→069. Return from sea to established sunny mooring correctly changes the raised sail to furled. Dealer stall and modest purse/cloth distribution remain coherent; the folded replacement garment stays separate from Tom's unchanged clothes. The tavern/night entry is intentional and all endpoint images are filled.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 069→070 through 077→078. Tavern meal, patching, beach hull inspection, deck dispute, isolated supporting-sailor aside and subsequent worried quay discussion are distinct deliberate scene changes. Repaired/furled sail state continues after repair, and captain/quartermaster identities stay stable. No black or failed transition observed.

Observed both encoded sides of cuts 078→079 through 084→085 plus the actual first and last movie frames. The sunny quay changes deliberately to sunset and then lantern-lit night. The final bucket callback preserves Tom's costume and the same hold ladder/mast/hammocks seen at the actual first frame. Both movie endpoints are fully formed images; no blank ending, black start or material subject clipping observed.
